metadata.documentation: 449 MHz Profiler winds and moments collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the M2HATS (Multi-point Monin-Obukhov similarity horizontal array turbulence study) field campaign in Tonopah, Nevada. Daily NetCDF-3 files of 449 MHz radar wind profiles are available as 5 minute and 30 minute averaged winds, and 30s moments. A Zarr store was created that preserves all three products in separate groups within a single daily store.
